job.job_description:
What You Must Have


- At least a Bachelor's degree

- At least 4 years of experience

- Oral and written proficiency in English required


What Sets You Apart


- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering

- Excelling in client-focused relationship building and management

- Navigating complex situations with critical thinking and problem-solving

- Utilizing coding standards and code review for software engineering

- Design and build full-stack features end-to-end React/TypeScript front-ends and Python/FastAPI back-ends for GenAI agent products

- Architect and implement LLM-powered agent workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI to automate managed-services business processes

- Implementing continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices

- Comfortable with SQL/NoSQL, data modeling, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP)

- Developing proficiency in React Native and scripting languages

- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions
